In detail

A deelgemeente of Ghent outside the historic core. Ghent publishes crime figures by wijk and by month as open data, and its police report two consecutive years of decline: 31,074 recorded offences in 2025, down 3,418 or 10% on 2024. Pickpocketing fell from 1,026 cases to 564 — a drop of 45% — and burglaries, bicycle thefts and thefts from cars all fell sharply too. Snatch thefts went from 168 to 122. The city's per-wijk open data exists but was not read area by area for this review, so no separate finding is claimed here. The dashed outline says that plainly.

Frequently asked questions

Is Drongen safe?

Wandroz rates Drongen in Ghent as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Ghent. That rating rests on an area-level review that reached no traveller-relevant reporting specific to Drongen — no incidents, no recurring problems, nothing documented either way — read together with the character of the area. It is not a positive finding of safety: an absence of reporting is weaker evidence than the sourced ratings elsewhere on this map, and it is marked as such wherever it appears.

What was checked for Drongen?

The same area-level review every other neighbourhood on the Ghent map gets: local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist, searched for this specific area. Drongen returned nothing traveller-relevant, which is common for smaller administrative areas without a press profile of their own. Where a review does return something, the sources are named on the area's page.

Is Drongen a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Nothing documented argues against it. For a stay, weigh that against the areas on the Ghent map whose ratings are backed by named sources, and check recent reviews for the specific street. You can search accommodation already scoped to this area using the Booking.com link on this page.
